questions Q1/Q2/Q3 and film omission of.Q1: Annual +300% endpoint in H104 active days at the primary N300/f.03/b.5/d1/P; compare no-edge field with two one-account +.10R/+.20R alternatives. A non-discriminating recipe is not skill evidence.
questions Q1/Q2/Q3 and film omission of.Q2: Fixed retrospective record: SAME identity W>=4 podiums/5 AND G5 podiums/5 including >=2 wins. Threshold, not exact order or loose nine-of-ten; selected before plan lock but after seeing record; not discovery significance.
questions Q1/Q2/Q3 and film omission of.Q3: Report-only presentation of a registered question omitted from the film: one account, f.03, b.5, d1, cost .02R, $1,500 floor, 150 active days, +300% endpoint at least half the time. Registered grid bracket p=[.88,1], width .12; cost break-even p=.68; net edge [.30,.48] R/trade. q(.88)=.363587588044 and q(1)=1. This is a sufficient grid endpoint, not an exact minimum or sizing advice. Fixed grid has 42 points (step .005 from break-even, then forced 1); the last gap is retained.

prior expectation: Fixed before the run: a selected single-year extreme may be less informative than persistent finishes. This was an expectation, not a measured result.
registered decision rules: Validity and support first. Q1 stronger +.20R alternative probability below .10 makes the recipe NON-DISCRIMINATING. For eligible labels, simultaneous U<=.01 is RARE UNDER THIS REGISTERED MODEL; L>=.10 is WITHIN THIS MODEL'S LUCK ENVELOPE; otherwise CANNOT TELL. Q2 headline is rare if its three components are rare, envelope if a component is envelope, otherwise unresolved; no pooled probability. Registered same-identity J rows across either arm can trigger the assumption-sensitive framing; a retrospective selection adjustment is absent.
same-identity predicate: Fixed retrospective record: SAME identity W>=4 podiums/5 AND G5 podiums/5 including >=2 wins. Threshold, not exact order or loose nine-of-ten; selected before plan lock but after seeing record; not discovery significance.
retrospective selection: Fixed retrospective record. Chosen after observing the archive, then locked before simulation. ANY searches identities within a field, not possible historical targets. The 72-row film subset was selected post-results from registered cells; the 29 qualifying rows were selected by their outcome. Neither is the full study.
calendars: World calendar-year and Global June–May windows overlap on a 72-month model scaffold. Thirteen active dates in odd months and twelve in even give 150/year. Q2 schedules 900 active-day draws across six years; 813 unique days are used by the joint ten-event windows. D1 shares histories on overlaps; D0 separates World/Global outcomes. The 813 count was launch-addendum telemetry, not a changed calendar. Arm B Q1 samples 2012–2025; Q2 starts 2012–2020 and follows consecutive years.

risk/payoff/activity/funding/cost/floor.primary: Arm A headline: assumed 300 people, payoff 0.5 times risk, one trade/active day, 150 days/year, cost 0.02R per trade, $1,500 absolute floor, one separately funded $5,000 account/person/event; shared overlapping histories; ANY identity matching the fixed joint record. Fixed 3% risk (F03) and guessed persistent risk mixtures FU/FH are separate components; no pooling. Real entrants/accounts unknown.
risk/payoff/activity/funding/cost/floor.sensitivity: For the designated replacement in the 72-row post-results subset: persistent 2% or 3% risk versus 0.2% opponents; 150 active days/year; one or two trades/day; guessed payoff 0.5, 1 or 2 times risk; independent account strategies; three separately funded $5,000 entries per person, fresh each event after ruin; zero trading costs and no loss floor. Assumed field sizes and overlap choices vary; real-world calibration is unknown.
risk/payoff/activity/funding/cost/floor.mixtures: Risks .002,.01,.02,.03,.04,.05 persist by identity across accounts/events. FU weights (1,1,1,1,1,1)/6; FH weights (1,1,2,2,2,2)/10. These are guessed distributions, not measured contestants.
risk/payoff/activity/funding/cost/floor.rules: Rank positive-return people with at least ten completed trades by best qualifying account; continuous tie keys. Arm A account strategies are independent; Arm B shares direction across an identity’s accounts on an active day, with different entries. Accounts have separate funding. No replacement people after failure; fresh event funding is a model assumption. Primary absolute floor absorbs strictly below $1,500; equality survives. Stop the day at equity at or below 50% of day-start equity; resume next active day if surviving. Removing floor does not remove insolvency.
risk/payoff/activity/funding/cost/floor.scope: A sensitivities include C0 zero cost, C05 .05R, L0 no floor, K3 three accounts, and JOINT zero cost/no floor/three accounts; payoff .5/1/2, activity 1/2, N100/300/1000. HK and causal own-equity RAISE are additional registered sensitivities, not the 72-row subset.

field repetition counts and intervals: Original lock unchanged: Arm A Q2 M=1,640; Arm B M=320; simultaneous 95% Clopper–Pearson with fixed family J=51,846; ordinary 95% intervals separately retained. Exact A Q1/Q3 use numerical probabilities, not fabricated Monte Carlo counts. Historical slices use actual slice denominators and ordinary intervals; they do not veto pooled labels. Shared variants are correlated.
Arm B proxy and data gap: SPY/QQQ 2012-2025 liquid-index intraday proxy, not oil/DAX or multiday/weekend reconstruction; 320 fields, simultaneous zero-hit upper .044435345167, too coarse for 1% rare band. Precision failure is not refutation. DATA-GAP REVIEWED - ACCEPTED WITH DISCLOSURE (29 of 3,520 sessions excluded, incl. the four March-2020 halt days). Complete regular minutes required for both SPY/QQQ; 32 of 32 early-close sessions retained. One of 14 years and seven of 168 months tripped the gap criterion; launch addendum accepted disclosure without relaxing eligibility. Broader B payoff, stop, cost, enforcement, private/high-risk grids were excluded before lock. Fair directions do not guarantee zero expected bracket return.

membership_scope: Post-results subset of registered cells: Arm A F002 JOINT designated-replacement J rows, N100/300/1000, b0.5/1/2, d1/2, D0/D1, S02/S03. Excludes ANY, W-only/G-only, other risks/configurations, Q1/Q1_ALT/Q3, Arm B and report-only diagnostics. The 29 qualifying rows are selected by their envelope label; the 43 others are CANNOT TELL.

membership_column_definitions.simultaneous_interval: Stored 95% interval adjusted across fixed family J=51,846.
membership_column_definitions.label: Registered cell classification; others here are CANNOT TELL, not proven rare.

study_coverage: Registered 218,202 cells: A Q1 62,214; A Q1_ALT 101,076; A Q2 15,558; A Q3 3,066; B Q1 31,104; B Q2 5,184. This report summarizes main questions, primary results, precision, scope and deficiencies; its result ledger prints the 72-row film subset, not the entire raw registry. Report-only alternative targets, historical slices, analytical comparisons, other per-cell diagnostics and raw alternative rows are not reproduced cell by cell. The two unretained diagnostic series remain unavailable.
